en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A boundary of Arafaat is from Al-Mazameen up to the end of the Pausing Station’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The boundary of ‘Arafat is from al-Mazemin to the end of the station.’”
